parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activity records for the human single-protein target Cytochrome P450 1A2 identified by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3356. Return columns: compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures, INNER JOIN, non-null), compound_key (from compound_records), pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer docs.pubmed_id, fallback docs.doi), assay_description (from assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name), target_organism (from target_dictionary.organism). Filter activities where standard_type = 'IC50'. Join path: activities (indexed on assay_id) -> assays on assay_id -> target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid, filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3356'. Also join activities -> compound_records on activities.record_id = compound_records.record_id -> docs on compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id (require non-null pubmed_id or doi). Join activities -> molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno. INNER JOIN compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno to ensure non-null canonical_smiles. Keep all qualifying activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
